purpose: Teach: 一豊/姫路/遡る/騒がせ/無口/高台/打線/東京ドーム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業地ゆかりの、本気で、絶対、一豊、絶対、関連、絶対、当社、絶対、研究しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Research our founding legacy and Yamauchi Kazutoyo's connection to us—I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Crisp consonants on the key demand. Weight on the historical reference, then steady eye contact on the close. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。姫路、本気で、絶対、支店、絶対、開設、絶対、検討、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively considering opening a branch in Himeji and moving forward with those plans.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Steady cadence, no hesitation. Slight uptick of confidence on the concrete location name. Respectful but assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の歴史を、本気で、絶対、遡る、絶対、と、絶対、お父さんの代、絶対、思い起こされる、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When I trace back our company's history, it reminds me of your father's time leading us.
lines.style: Quieter shift. Reflective, looking inward slightly. Pause before the memory. Spoken with genuine appreciation, not flattery. Slower pace—this matters to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気for、絶対、業界を、絶対、騒がせ、絶対、ない、絶対、慎重な、絶対、姿勢、絶対、保っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're maintaining a careful, conservative approach—we don't want to create unnecessary noise in the industry.
lines.style: Measured explanation. Deliberate pacing on the principle itself. Shows he's thought this through. Respectful tone: this caution reflects the company's values, not timidity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 記者会見、本気で、絶対、無口、絶対、では、絶対、駄目だ、絶対、説明、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: A press conference with silence won't work. You need to explain thoroughly and make our position clear.
lines.style: Sharper directive. Brisk tempo. Firm but not harsh—this is a standard he expects. Weight on the verb 'explain.' The close carries quiet insistence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、高台、絶対、にある、絶対、本社、絶対、防災、絶対、対策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our headquarters is positioned on high ground, and we're implementing disaster preparedness measures to protect the company.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring detail. Shows forward-thinking without self-congratulation. Steady delivery on the practical measures. Confidence in execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロ野球の、本気で、絶対、打線、絶対、と、絶対、当社、絶対、スポンサー契約、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Move forward with a sponsorship contract with a professional baseball team and their lineup.
lines.style: Quick shift in tone—lighter intent beneath the directive. Slight energy lift on 'baseball.' Not frivolous, but this is about visibility and goodwill. Clear command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。東京ドーム、本気で、絶対、イベントの、絶対、協賛、絶対、検討、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're exploring sponsorship opportunities for events at the Tokyo Dome and considering our involvement.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Smooth, practiced delivery. Shows responsiveness to the previous direction. Confident wrap—the kind of update that earns a nod. Slight warmth on 'Tokyo Dome.'
